text:
taylor: FYI we've been getting a handful of reports from new users that the quickstart hangs and then they see 429s when they run multiple paginated workers in parallel. Seems to be client-side bursting + no smoothing in the JS SDK.
nina: Oh no. Any repro?
raj: Yep, reproduced locally. Quick script that iterates paginator and spawns work for each page ends up with 100+ inflight briefly. Server-side pool saturates and returns soft 429s which clients retry and make worse.
taylor: Example naive pattern many copies use:
```js
for await (const page of paginator) {
  // spawn work without bound
  doWork(page).catch(() => {});
}
```
This is what users paste from quickstart, then they add concurrency later and get surprises.
nina: Two levers: (1) show a bounded concurrency pattern in quickstart, (2) add a small opt-in backpressure helper in SDKs for parity.
raj: Also found an SDK bug: when a request gets a 429 the retry path retries but doesn't decrement the in-flight counter or release any local semaphore slot before scheduling the retry sleep. That means the client thinks the slot is still in use and you get effective oversubscription during backoff windows.
taylor: Oof. So fix needs to handle: decrement on all error/retry paths, make release idempotent, and provide an example using try/finally.
docs-bot: Note: Python SDK already has an AsyncLimiter context manager example in docs. JS quickstart lacked an official helper.
nina: Proposed quickstart snippet (bounded concurrency):
```js
const limiter = client.backpressure({ maxConcurrent: 8 });
for await (const page of paginator) {
  await limiter.acquire();
  processPage(page).finally(() => limiter.release());
}
```
This demonstrates finally and avoids leaking slots.
raj: Implementation plan: 1) patch sample-app quickstart with the bounded example (hotfix), 2) JS SDK: add opt-in backpressure helper + ensure counters decrement on retry/error, 3) mirror in Go/Py for parity, 4) add client telemetry metric `client.inflight` and console warning when drift occurs >15s.
taylor: Tests: add unit sim that fires 200 acquires while server returns intermittent 429s and assert inflight <= max+1. Also add token refresh failure case to ensure slots free if auth fails mid-retry.
ci-bot: CI queued for branch `fix/smoothing-window`  tests will run.
docs-bot: Filed DOCS-945 quickstart update and guidance on pagination/backpressure.
nina: One UX note: highlight this change in onboarding channel, because many customers copy quickstart verbatim.
raj: I'll open the JS SDK PR and include the idempotent release + decrement-on-retry changes. Taylor, can you handle sample app patch and docs?
taylor: Yep, will do. Also adding a short note in quickstart explaining warmup and why smoothing matters.
ci-bot: CI: `fix/smoothing-window` tests started.
nina: Thanks team  this should cut down onboarding confusion and reduce early soft-429 support tickets.
